flags.reason: misreads-source: The guide's In context sheet has an App Bar titled “Ask HelloJio” (the live-example text), and Sources says the dialog is “named by its App Bar title”. The example's AppBar has no title, so the dialog would be unnamed. That contradicts the guide and /accessibility/4 (“Give the App Bar a title”).

notes: /examples/1 and /examples/2 also render an AppBar with no title, so their dialogs would be unnamed too; consider adding a title to all three. /configuration/8 cites the types fact that a scrim with no onOverlayPress calls onRequestClose, but the evidence's Coin gaps (#234, still open as of 13 October) says “the scrim press doesn't call onRequestClose”. A human should check which holds on the 0.1.78-dbe0e02 build. /configuration/12 states the HelloJio field turns white without the evidence's conditions (only when the field colour matches the sheet, and not when the input sets jioPlus). The guide's own wording is unconditional, so this is not flagged.
